title: Exact Mersenne Factor Censuses and a Finite Bernoulli Multiplicity Model
description:
Technical report and reproducibility materials for the bounded P12 experiment. Two independent exhaustive programs counted 487,025 factor pairs for prime exponents 10,000,001 through 30,000,000 and k at most 10,000. External operator reviews report exact sealed census matches in region 1 and region 2. The report transcribes the region 1 scores, compares fixed Poisson and Poisson-binomial multiplicity models on region 2 and its extension, and records a residual discrepancy and the lack of an external pre-run prediction timestamp for region 2. No new theorem, law or credited factor is claimed.

The report and its LaTeX source are CC BY 4.0. Original project code is MIT-licensed; vendored GNU mini-gmp and third-party material retain their own terms, as detailed in LICENSING.md. The deposit includes the raw census outputs and recorded evidence; provenance checks require full Git history, supplied separately as a Git bundle in the reproducibility package.
